text.name: Fortune Stone
text.description:
{Fortune Stone (Basic)}

In battle, lets you use {Rune of Fortune (H7)}: summons a Fortune Stone.
Learning {Runes} improves the effect.
Has 3 uses; needs no spellbook and costs no Spell Points.
When the uses run out, the Rune Stone disappears.
text.event: A stone slab carved with blue runes lies by the road. When your fingertips touch it, you feel your luck improving. You obtain a Fortune Stone.
